page.overview:
Who is Barbara Kretizer?

Barbara "Babs" Burns (née Kretizer) was the wife of Bensonhurst Burns and the mother of Rudolph, Cassandra, and Wainwright Montgomery Burns.

She was the paternal great-grandmother of Springfield's richest man, Charles Montgomery Burns.

She looks like her great-granddaughter-in-law Hortensia Patterson
